serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
OATI services focus on data / transaction management, warehousing, and retrieval in real-time. These services are delivered via OATI managed Data Centers that are equipped with multiple redundant systems and networks and provide a secure production application environment, with multiple redundant systems and networks.
OATI provides services to over 700 energy industry organizations in North America. Over 90% of the wholesale power entities in North America use OATI services in their operations. OATI, as a provider of SaaS, reduces the burden and expense for energy industry participants who must deploy mission-critical software that complies with industry regulations and Sarbanes-Oxley requirements (SOX).
